title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_croquis_de_paris_by_maurice_demaison_henri_de_regnier_v6bgx (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_croquis_de_paris_by_maurice_demaison_henri_de_regnier_v6bgx' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted machine. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it.
